status: Release approved by Robert, decision 662; validation pending
source: Two retained historical client-observed Campaign histories (Assassin and Golemancer) inspected and copied under .wrangler/testing-0.215-2026-11-06/real-campaign. They predate this topology revision and do not measure route-offer selection under it. No relevant real-player Arena exports or new-topology Campaign positions available. No new matches or simulations.
basis: Decision 661, explicitly included in release approval 662: fixed convergence every six floors becomes an independent 8% meeting chance on each middle floor. Otherwise lane width drifts -1/0/+1 within 2-5, or chooses 2-5 after a meeting. Five starts, two final shrines, stops per path and node-kind/reward definitions remain. The sequence/count of available alternative stops changes, so practical opportunities to find a merchant, optional fight or event can change even with unchanged per-node rules. Saved maps remain intact. Art/checkmarks are presentation only. Preserve all prior unmeasured combat grades; deterministic topology checks establish graph properties, not strength or player behavior.
target: Arena first: distinct competitive styles at1000HP; typical10+ own turns. Drago optimized-deck target roughly50% or somewhat above, pending representative human/deck evidence.

ratings.name: Paladin

arena.long: Not established beyond ten own turns

ratings.setup: One stronger Strike is optional. Two-Mana manual attacks compete with Aura setup; Raised Hell itself remains 2 Mana and requires later Strike draws. Rarity is not guaranteed acquisition. Route change: access to alternative setup/reward stops may vary with irregular branch widths; no new guaranteed acquisition.
ratings.recovery: Breaching Strike grants no Barrier, healing or draw. Spending 2 Mana instead of 1 can reduce defense that turn. Shield Strike retains 5/8 damage and 5/6 Barrier; unchanged recovery cards remain necessary. Route change: no direct healing/rebuild effect; available alternative stops may differ before the same final pair of shrines.
ratings.rareReliance: Breaching Strike changes Common -> Rare. Raised Hell remains an optional Rare; together they raise acquisition dependence. Shield Strike remains Common and Muster Strike Uncommon; early builds still have lower-rarity support. Rarity and reward amounts remain; the set of optional routes can change acquisition opportunities, with unmeasured benefit by style.
ratings.scaling: A larger fixed hit plus 2 Exposed improves attack follow-up when a target survives; Exposed is applied after this hit. Existing Might/Exposed multipliers and duration rules remain. Each copy counts once for Mastered Strike. Repeated free casts need draws and the Aura; no new self-draw or resource loop.
ratings.rationale: Carry forward 0.213.0 unmeasured combat assessments without a grade change. Irregular route convergence can change practical acquisition and optional-stop choice in Campaign; no class-specific superiority or improvement is inferred.
ratings.watch: Compare Campaign I-III starts, IV-VII setup, VIII-X consistency and XI-XII finale preparation with exact chosen routes and offered rewards. Distinguish generated-map seed variation, difficulty, Boons and player intent. Arena opening, 6-10 and 11+ own turns are unaffected mechanically and remain unmeasured.
ratings.confidence: Low for new-route acquisition effects; no player observations under this topology. Combat estimates remain unchanged and unmeasured.
ratings.pacing: No combat, HP, seats, AI, clock or damage changes. Arena 10+ own turns and roughly 50% optimized Drago clears remain targets, not measured results.
